language.title: Language spoofing
language.description: Override the language seen by selected app processes.
language.ruleHelp: One language per application and Android user. Saving a rule does not enable spoofing.
language.userHelp: Use 0 for the main user. Work profiles and secondary users have separate IDs. The app picker lists apps visible to the manager.
language.localeHelp: Language tag, for example en-US, ja-JP or zh-Hant-TW.
language.restart: Fully close and reopen the target apps after saving, enabling or disabling. Existing processes keep their current language.
language.limits: Requires Zygisk. Changes the language seen by selected apps without changing your device language. Cached values and some app-specific or native checks may bypass it. Layout and regional content may change; ad removal is not guaranteed.
language.unavailable: Update and enable Duck ToolBox, then reboot to load the language runtime.
language.changed: The configuration changed elsewhere. Refresh before saving or enabling; local edits will be discarded only after confirmation.
language.empty: No applications selected. Add a rule to get started.

errors.duplicate_rule: This application already has a rule for that Android user.
errors.invalid_config: The language configuration is invalid. Disable spoofing before repairing the saved rules.
errors.stale_revision: The configuration changed. Refresh before trying again.
errors.operation_busy: Another language operation is running. Try again shortly.
errors.empty_rules: Add and save at least one application rule first.
errors.state_unavailable: The language configuration could not be read or written.
errors.runtime_unavailable: Update and enable Duck ToolBox, then reboot to load the language runtime.
errors.config_too_large: Language rules exceed 64 KiB. Remove some rules before saving.
